title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1969-09-26

ai_review.summary: Mixed feelings: life‑changing music for some, but a poor‑quality tape plagued by audible duplication issues.
ai_review.review: The show resonates strongly with at least one listener who calls it a life‑changing first experience, yet the recording itself is widely criticized for being a reused tape that audibly repeats on "King Bee" and around 6:12 of "Death Don't Have No Mercy," making the audio quality poor.

ai_rating.rationale: One enthusiastic 5‑star review balances two strongly negative ratings that cite serious recording flaws; with limited musical detail, the overall rating leans low.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Tape appears to have been used twice; audible duplication on "King Bee" and a clear artifact at 6:12 of "Death Don't Have No Mercy" indicates significant degradation.
